hero.heading: Research
hero.subheading: The Trust by Design framework is open research. If you're building responsible AI, use it. That's what it's for.
areas.heading: Research areas
areas.bias.title: Bias in AI training data
areas.bias.desc: Investigating demographic gaps between AI training data and real-world user populations, with a focus on older adults, children, and patients.
areas.explainability.title: Explainability standards
areas.explainability.desc: Developing practical tests for whether AI decisions are genuinely understandable to the people affected by them.
areas.inclusion.title: Digital inclusion for older adults
areas.inclusion.desc: Understanding how AI systems fail people over 60 -- and what that reveals about systemic design assumptions.
areas.governance.title: Governance frameworks
areas.governance.desc: Building decision tools that translate EU AI Act requirements into daily product decisions for design and engineering teams.
open.heading: Open by design
open.body: All research from the Trust by Design framework is published openly. If you're a designer, researcher, or product person trying to make the case for bias testing, fairness reviews, or explainability standards inside your organisation -- use it.
cta.heading: Interested in collaboration?
cta.body: I work with academic institutions, public-sector organisations, and product teams on applied research.
